name: sticxcape
description: SticXcape: the motion-capture stick-figure fighting game

scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run build:lab -w @sticxcape/server && npm run build -w @sticxcape/client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.check.json && tsc -p apps/client/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/client/tsconfig.test.json
